component: Related-items xpcshell assertion helper and its callers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: checkLoginsMap is async but has no await, and the inspected test calls invoke it without awaiting or returning its Promise. Its assertion still executes during the call; a thrown assertion becomes a rejected returned Promise rather than a synchronous throw to the task. The callers do not observe that Promise. This is a static completion-boundary finding; the harness's unhandled-rejection behavior and a passing or failing test result were not established.
title: The related-items task does not observe its async dependency assertion helper
